title: A copy that drops unlisted marks past the manifest bound fails; its source is kept
notes: Each server's 11 skills fit the manifest; both servers' together do not. Every skill is unlisted, so the registry's manifest is empty. A copy without the marks would list them all and fails with the manifest-size error, its source unchanged; a copy keeping the marks is made. RK-24.5-012 is cited in part (see served-skills/each-operation-that-would-pass-the-manifest-bound-fails-before-it-changes-anything).

results.message: the skills' manifest would take 70768 characters, past 65536
